title: Real Estate Platform
description: A cross-platform real-estate platform with linked map and list search, rich listing detail, saved searches, and tour booking—backed by a production-ready FastAPI + PostgreSQL API and a Next.js + Material UI admin dashboard for complete property and user management.
impact: End-to-end real-estate product spanning map-driven discovery, tour scheduling, and agent contact on six platforms, with a matching backend API and admin dashboard for listings, agents, tours, inquiries, and analytics.
responsibilities: Built linked map and list search with bounds querying, pin clustering, and synchronized map-list interactions.
Developed rich listing detail with photo galleries, amenities, filters, and schedule-a-tour booking flows.
Implemented saved searches, favorited properties, and agent contact across iOS, Android, web, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
Delivered a FastAPI + PostgreSQL REST API with JWT authentication and geospatial listing search.
Built a Next.js + Material UI admin dashboard for listings, agents, tours, inquiries, users, and analytics.
achievements: Shipped a production-quality cross-platform real-estate app with Material 3 and adaptive layouts from phone to desktop.
Backed the Flutter client with a contract-aligned API and staff admin tools for full property and user management.
Covered the complete real-estate journey from map-driven discovery through tour booking and operational analytics.
